verdict.rationale: Brex's own product describes one native multi-item action: booking accruals for incomplete expenses with one click. Its developer docs also say a Pipedream integration enables bulk creating users, but that bulk logic runs in a third-party low-code platform rather than as a Brex capability, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: general bulk-edit/bulk-action capability across items in the product, documented bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk operations via the MCP server, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Book accruals for incomplete expenses with one click to close the books every day
